description: Send the same prompt to 2-5 Bedrock models, then have a judge model (default Claude Opus) score the answers blind - shuffled and labeled A/B/C with model names hidden - and pick a winner. Set synthesize to also get one merged answer that keeps the best of each.

criteria.description: What the judge scores on (default 'correctness, completeness, clarity and concision')

effort.description: Thinking depth and token spend for models that take it (Claude except Haiku 4.5, GPT-6.1, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4 up to xhigh): low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to medium. bedrock_ask rejects it for other models; bedrock_compare and bedrock_judge apply it only to the models that take it.

models.description: List of 2-5 candidate model aliases or IDs (e.g. ['kimi', 'nova-pro', 'deepseek'])

synthesize.description: Also return one merged final answer (default false)

system.description: Optional system prompt sent to the candidates

name: bedrock_judge
